description: Implementation of the DisplayVk class methods for Vulkan rendering in ANGLE, including initialization, device management, surface and context creation, extension and capability generation, error handling, and feature population.

classes.name: DisplayVk
classes.description: Class implementing Vulkan display functionalities for ANGLE, managing initialization, device status, surface and context creation, extension and capability reporting, error handling, and feature management.

methods.name: DisplayVk
methods.description: Constructor initializing the DisplayVk object with display state, creating a RendererVk instance, and setting up a scratch buffer.

methods.name: ~DisplayVk
methods.description: Destructor cleaning up the RendererVk instance.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the Vulkan renderer with the display, handling result conversion and error reporting.

methods.name: terminate
methods.description: Terminates the renderer, cleaning up resources.

methods.name: makeCurrent
methods.description: Stub function for making a surface current; currently does nothing.

methods.name: testDeviceLost
methods.description: Checks if the Vulkan device has been lost.

methods.name: restoreLostDevice
methods.description: Returns an error as Vulkan devices cannot be restored without re-creating the renderer.

methods.name: getVendorString
methods.description: Returns the vendor string, including the renderer's vendor info.

methods.name: createDevice
methods.description: Unimplemented method for device creation.

methods.name: waitClient
methods.description: Waits for client operations to complete, using context finish.

methods.name: waitNative
methods.description: Unimplemented method for native wait.

methods.name: createWindowSurface
methods.description: Creates a window surface from a native window.

methods.name: createPbufferSurface
methods.description: Creates an offscreen pbuffer surface.

methods.name: createPbufferFromClientBuffer
methods.description: Unimplemented method for creating pbuffer from client buffer.

methods.name: createPixmapSurface
methods.description: Unimplemented method for creating pixmap surface.

methods.name: createImage
methods.description: Creates an ImageVk object.

methods.name: createContext
methods.description: Creates a ContextVk object for rendering context.

methods.name: createStreamProducerD3DTexture
methods.description: Unimplemented method for stream producer from D3D texture.

methods.name: createSync
methods.description: Creates an EGLSyncVk object.

methods.name: getMaxSupportedESVersion
methods.description: Returns the maximum supported OpenGL ES version.

methods.name: getMaxConformantESVersion
methods.description: Returns the maximum conformant OpenGL ES version.

methods.name: generateExtensions
methods.description: Populates extension support flags for the display.

methods.name: generateCaps
methods.description: Populates capabilities such as NPOT textures.

methods.name: getWSILayer
methods.description: Returns nullptr, indicating no specific WSI layer.

methods.name: getScratchBuffer
methods.description: Retrieves a scratch buffer of requested size.

methods.name: handleError
methods.description: Handles Vulkan errors, logs error string, and notifies device loss if applicable.

methods.name: getEGLError
methods.description: Returns an EGL error object with stored error string.

methods.name: populateFeatureList
methods.description: Populates feature list based on renderer features.
